versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the save skill, providing a three-tier memory system for OpenClaw agents.
- Enables saving conversations as standalone markdown files, with automatic cross-referencing in a conversation log.
- Full-text FTS5 search index built and rebuilt using Python stdlib only—no external dependencies.
- Includes commands for index building, searching, and topic tag listing.
- Designed for privacy, persistence, and zero cloud dependence; all storage is local.
- Robust edge case handling (duplicate filenames, off-the-record saves, large conversations).
